cards.front: No entendí ni una palabra de lo que dijo él.
cards.back: I didn't understand a word he said.

cards.front: Carmen no entendió ni una palabra de lo que dijo Andrew. Estaba hablando entre dientes.
cards.back: Carmen didn't understand a word Andrew said. He was mumbling.

cards.front: No entendiste ni una palabra de lo que dijo ese tipo, ¿verdad? Estaba hablando entre dientes.
cards.back: You didn't understand a word the guy said, did you? He was mumbling.

cards.front: No entendí nada de lo que él dijo.
cards.back: I did not understand a thing he said.

cards.front: James no entendió nada de lo que dijo María. Ella estaba hablando entre dientes todo el tiempo.
cards.back: James did not understand a thing María said. She was mumbling the whole time.

cards.front: El tipo estaba hablando entre dientes todo el tiempo. No entendí nada de lo que dijo.
cards.back: The guy was mumbling the whole time. I did not understand a thing he said.

cards.front: Apuesto a que no entendiste ni una palabra. El interlocutor estaba hablando entre dientes todo el tiempo.
cards.back: I bet you didn't understand a word. The speaker was mumbling the whole time.

cards.front: Vieron una película en francés. Apuesto a que Jerry no entendió nada.
cards.back: They watched a film in French. I bet Jerry didn't understand a thing.

cards.front: Apuesto a que el equipo de ventas no entendió ni una palabra de eso.
cards.back: I bet the sales team didn't understand a word of that.

cards.front: Pillé unas cuantas palabras, pero Shreena no entendió nada en absoluto.
cards.back: I picked up a few words, but Shreena didn't understand at all.

cards.front: No entendiste nada en absoluto, ¿verdad? Yo pillé unas cuantas palabras.
cards.back: You didn't understand at all, did you? I picked up a few words.

cards.front: Ed pilló unas cuantas palabras, pero yo no entendí nada en absoluto.
cards.back: Ed picked up a few words, but I didn't understand at all.

cards.front: No entendí del todo lo que estabas diciendo. ¿Podrías repetirlo, por favor?
cards.back: I didn't fully understand what you were on about. Could you say it again?

cards.front: El tipo no entendió del todo lo que yo estaba diciendo.
cards.back: The guy didn't fully understand what I was on about.

cards.front: No entendimos del todo lo que decía el interlocutor, pero pillamos unas cuantas palabras.
cards.back: We didn't fully understand what the speaker was on about, but we picked up a few words.

cards.front: ¿Qué entiende ella por el término «puntual»?
cards.back: What does she understand by the term "punctual"?

cards.front: ¿Qué entiendes por «humor británico»?
cards.back: What do you understand by "British humour"?

cards.front: ¿Qué entiendes por «terrorismo»?
cards.back: What do you understand by "terrorism"?

cards.front: ¿Te lo tomaste como una invitación para todo el mundo?
cards.back: Did you understand it to be an open invitation?

cards.front: Me lo tomé a broma.
cards.back: I understood it to be a joke.

cards.front: Nos lo tomamos como una advertencia amistosa.
cards.back: We understood it to be a friendly warning.

cards.front: Según tenía entendido, querían hacernos una advertencia amistosa.
cards.back: As I understood it, they wanted to give us a friendly warning.

cards.front: Según teníamos entendido, era una invitación para todo el mundo.
cards.back: As we understood it, it was an open invitation.

cards.front: Según teníamos entendido, no necesitan ayuda.
cards.back: As we understood it, they don't need any help.

cards.front: Fue una broma, por lo que yo entendí.
cards.back: It was just a joke, as I understood it.

cards.front: Por lo que ellos entendieron, estaban invitados también.
cards.back: As they understood it, they were invited too.

cards.front: No quieren ayuda, por lo que yo entiendo.
cards.back: They don't want any help, as I understand it.

cards.front: Si he entendido bien, sólo es una advertencia amistosa.
cards.back: If I understand, it's just a friendly warning.

cards.front: Si lo he entendido bien, no necesitan ayuda.
cards.back: If I understand, they don't need any help.

cards.front: Si he entendido bien, no deberíamos hacer preguntas.
cards.back: If I understand, we shouldn't ask any questions.

cards.front: Perdona, ¡no lo pillo!
cards.back: Sorry, I don't get it!

cards.front: ¡Perdona, pero aún no lo pillo!
cards.back: Sorry, but I still don't get it!

cards.front: Apuesto a que François no pilla la broma. Es humor británico.
cards.back: I bet François doesn't get the joke. It's British humour.

cards.front: No es complicado. ¿Lo pillas?
cards.back: It isn't complicated. Do you get it?

cards.front: ¿Ya lo pillas?
cards.back: Do you get it yet?

cards.front: He explicado mi argumento tres veces. ¿Ya lo pillas?
cards.back: I've explained my argument three times. Do you get it yet?

cards.front: ¿Pillas de qué está hablando él?
cards.back: Do you get what he's on about?

cards.front: ¿Pilla Sophie de qué está hablando él?
cards.back: Does Sophie get what he's on about?

cards.front: ¿Pilla alguien qué quiere decir él?
cards.back: Does anyone get what he means?

cards.front: Vale, vale, lo pillo.
cards.back: OK, OK, I get it.

cards.front: Gracias por explicármelo. Ahora lo pillo.
cards.back: Thanks for explaining it to me. I get it now.

cards.front: Pienso que lo pilla ella. Se lo he explicado cinco veces.
cards.back: I think she gets it. I've explained it to her five times.

cards.front: Perdona, todavía no lo pillo del todo.
cards.back: Sorry, I still don't fully get it.

cards.front: No, no lo pillo para nada.
cards.back: No, I don't get it at all.

cards.front: Ella no pilla del todo lo que está diciendo él.
cards.back: She doesn't fully get what he's on about.

cards.front: Ésta es tu última oportunidad. ¿Queda claro?
cards.back: This is your last chance. Do I make myself understood?

cards.front: No hay segundas oportunidades. ¿Queda claro?
cards.back: There are no second chances. Do I make myself understood?

cards.front: No volverás a hacer eso. ¿Queda claro?
cards.back: You will not do that again. Do I make myself understood?

cards.front: Quizás no me explicase bien. No se permite que nadie entre ahí.
cards.back: Perhaps I didn't make myself understood. No one is allowed to go in there.

cards.front: Quizás no me explicase bien. No existen las segundas oportunidades.
cards.back: Perhaps I didn't make myself understood. There are no second chances.

cards.front: Quizás no me explicase bien. ¡No estoy interesada en ti!
cards.back: Perhaps I didn't make myself understood. I'm not interested in you!

cards.front: Espero que ella se explicase bien cuando dijo por qué se iba.
cards.back: I hope she made herself understood when she explained why she was leaving.

cards.front: Espero que ella se explicase bien cuando le dijo a él que era su última oportunidad.
cards.back: I hope she made herself understood when she told him it was his last chance.

cards.front: Espero que ella se explicase bien cuando les dijo que no entrasen allí.
cards.back: I hope she made herself understood when she told them not to go in there.

cards.front: No lograron hacerse entender la primera vez.
cards.back: They failed to make themselves understood the first time.

cards.front: No lograron hacerse entender y ahora tienen que repetirse.
cards.back: They failed to make themselves understood and now they have to repeat themselves.

cards.front: Si no logras hacerte entender la primera vez, tendrás que repetirte.
cards.back: If you fail to make yourself understood the first time, you'll have to repeat yourself.

cards.front: A él le cuesta hacerse entender. Siempre tiene que repetirse.
cards.back: He finds it difficult to make himself understood. He always has to repeat himself.

cards.front: Es un poco rarito. Le cuesta hacerse entender.
cards.back: He's a bit awkward. He finds it difficult to make himself understood.

cards.front: Era un poco rarito. Creo que le costaba hacerse entender.
cards.back: He was awkward. I think he found it difficult to make himself understood.

cards.front: Intenté hablar con ellos, pero no entienden por lo que estoy pasando.
cards.back: I tried talking to them but they don't understand what I'm going through.

cards.front: Ella intentó hablar con sus amigos, pero no entienden por lo que está pasando.
cards.back: She tried talking to her friends but they don't understand what she's going through.

cards.front: Él intentó hablar con ella, pero él no entiende por lo que ella está pasando.
cards.back: He tried talking to her but he doesn't understand what she's going through.

cards.front: Nadie entiende lo que es eso.
cards.back: No one understands what it's like.

cards.front: Nadie entiende lo que es ser yo.
cards.back: No one understands what it's like to be me.

cards.front: Intenté hablar con ella, pero ella dice que no entiendo lo que es eso.
cards.back: I tried talking to her but she says I don't understand what it's like.

cards.front: ¿Entiendes lo que se siente al ser despedido?
cards.back: Do you understand what it feels like to be sacked?

cards.front: ¿Entiende alguien lo que se siente al perderlo todo?
cards.back: Does anyone understand what it feels like to lose everything?

cards.front: ¿Entienden lo que se siente al ser acosado?
cards.back: Do they understand what it feels like to be bullied?

cards.front: Entiendo lo que se siente al ser despedido.
cards.back: I understand how it feels to be sacked.

cards.front: Intenta hablar con Caroline. Ella entiende lo que se siente al perderlo todo.
cards.back: Try talking to Caroline. She understands how it feels to lose everything.

cards.front: Mucha gente entiende lo que se siente al ser intimidado.
cards.back: A lot of people understand how it feels to be bullied.

cards.front: No entiendes lo difícil que fue para mí romper con ella.
cards.back: You don't understand how difficult it was for me to break up with her.

cards.front: Mi familia no entiende lo difícil que fue dejar el país.
cards.back: My family doesn't understand how difficult it was to leave the country.

cards.front: La gente no entiende lo difícil que fue tomar la decisión.
cards.back: People don't understand how difficult it was to make the decision.

cards.front: Ella es una persona muy comprensiva. No le importará.
cards.back: She's a very understanding person. She won't mind.

cards.front: Dile la verdad. Es una mujer muy comprensiva.
cards.back: Tell her the truth. She's an understanding woman.

cards.front: Gracias por ser tan comprensivo.
cards.back: Thank you for being so understanding.

cards.front: Es un error comprensible. ¡No me importa!
cards.back: It's an understandable mistake. I don't mind!

cards.front: Es una decisión comprensible.
cards.back: It's an understandable decision.

cards.front: Fue un error comprensible, pero no hay segundas oportunidades.
cards.back: It was an understandable mistake, but there are no second chances.

cards.front: ¿Has leído su redacción? ¡Es incomprensible!
cards.back: Have you read his essay? It's incomprehensible!

cards.front: Su letra es casi incomprensible, pero no me importa.
cards.back: His handwriting is almost incomprehensible, but I don't mind.

cards.front: Nunca cometería semejante error. ¡Sería incomprensible!
cards.back: I would never make such a terrible mistake. It would be incomprehensible!

cards.front: ¿Has entendido lo que quería decir él? Pensé que era un poco ambiguo.
cards.back: Did you understand what he meant? I thought it was a bit ambiguous.

cards.front: Él no se hizo entender. Todo fue un poco ambiguo.
cards.back: He didn't make himself understood. It was all a bit ambiguous.

cards.front: No saben hacerse entender. ¡Todo lo que dicen es ambiguo!
cards.back: They don't know how to make themselves understood. Everything they say is ambiguous!

cards.front: No hay nada ambiguo sobre ello. Está más claro que el agua.
cards.back: There's nothing ambiguous about it. It's as clear as day.

cards.front: No creo que la redacción sea incomprensible. Está más clara que el agua para mí.
cards.back: I don't think the essay is incomprehensible. It's as clear as day to me.

cards.front: ¡Lo que tenemos que hacer está más claro que el agua! Tenemos que trabajar nuestra pronunciación para hacernos entender.
cards.back: What we have to do is as clear as day! We have to work on our pronunciation and make ourselves understood.
